question.text: A compound (X) of molecular formula  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math>  forms bisulphate complex, gives iodoform test but does not reduce Tollens reagent. (X) on reaction with  <math><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi></mrow><mo>/</mo><mrow><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></mrow></mrow></math>  gives a compound (Y) that cannot

options.text: give red colour with Cerium Ammonium Nitrate (CAN)
give white turbidity immediately with Lucas reagent
be dehydrated to alkene on reaction with heated Cu

solution.text: In given conditions X C3H6O should be a methyl ketone.
